title: Mombacho
goal: Climb a volcano with a guide who talks the whole way
culture: Mombacho is the volcano you have been looking at from the plaza since your first morning. Going slowly up it is not a failure, it is the method, and ya casi is a kindness rather than a measurement.

beats.en: Are we going up the volcano?
beats.good: Mombacho is the shape on the horizon you have been looking at from Parque Central since your first morning. Today you are on it.

beats.es: Ahí arriba está el cráter. Hora y media.
beats.en: Up there, all the way to the crater?
beats.good: Ahí arriba — up there. He will point at cloud, because the top of it is in cloud most days of the year.

beats.es: Despacio, despacio. No hay prisa, joven.
beats.good: Despacio is the whole technique and he says it to everybody. Going slowly up a volcano is not failing at it, it is how it is done.

beats.es: Ya casi, ya casi. Ahí está.
beats.good: Ya casi means almost there and it is said from about the halfway point onwards. It is a kindness rather than a measurement.
